info.desc: FanMail is the third studio album to released by TLC. The album was highly anticipated by fans. It was scheduled for November 10, 1998 but got pushed back 3 months because they wanted it to be fully ready. It was their follow up to the massively successful album CrazySexyCool, which was released in 1994. It debuted at #1 on the Billboard Top 200 albums chart, with 318,000 copies sold and remained at #1 for 5 weeks. The album has since sold 6 million copies domestically and 11 million worldwide. It went platinum in Japan before going platinum in the U.S. .

podcast.body: This third album was released in 1999 after a tumultuous three-year hiatus. It became their fastest seller to date, debuting at number one and generating two Hot 100 number one songs, "No Scrubs" and "Unpretty." "the trio were persuaded to reunite for a third album, 1999's Fan Mail, that became their fastest seller to date, debuting at number one and generating two hot 100 number one songs."
